summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError, plus test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (42 passed), and the full test/test_extras run gives 100 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed. Nothing is committed and no core files changed. Not verified: mypy, black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-ignore comments and formatting were checked by reading only. The non-node check uses a candidate: Any local to avoid an unreachable-code warning under mypy; this is a judgment call.
